explanation: Nahuatl was the language of the Aztec empire. Spanish took tomatl, ahuacatl and chilli from it, and English took the words from Spanish.

claims.text: 'Tomato', 'avocado' and 'chilli' come, through Spanish, from Nahuatl tomatl, ahuacatl and chilli.
None of the three words comes from Quechua, Yucatec Maya or Guarani.
Nahuatl was the main language of the Aztec empire.
English took tomato, avocado and chilli from Spanish.
